lead_decisions_2026-11-06.1_P2_g: Where the task's answer is the readout's own value (ident32, copy-24, E62 copy, rank-1) g is fixed as the identity on classes, no fitting: P2 = agreement on held-out windows between the state's top-1 within the value set and the readout's argmax class at the site. Where the answer is not the readout's value (elicit, cipher-24, the text ciphers, rand32, lookup) g is removal.lookup_accuracy's table fitted on the fit windows (here removal.table_accuracy, the same table with fit and read rows given apart) and an unseen class counts wrong, as decision 2 filed: P2 is predicted low on those rows; a table cannot carry to new values, which is P1's failure seen again, not a new rule. E112's two-valued g stays the m = 2 case only for the table rows; at m = 2 the identity is a threshold at the probes' crossing (0.5) with fixed sign, not fitted.
lead_decisions_2026-11-06.2_P3_margin: The log-odds of the window's target within the task's value set S, log p(y|S) - log(1 - p(y|S)) (case_label.set_log_odds; E112's margin exactly at m = 2); the full-vocabulary log-odds and its share printed beside. A twin's P3 uses the twin's own value set.
lead_decisions_2026-11-06.3_key_slot: The excluded types and the Hewitt-Liang control are keyed on the slot where the key sits: t for the key tables and token identity on them, t-1 for E62 (copy and lookup) and E112, and for the text ciphers the token at t (the position whose next word is the ciphered target).
lead_decisions_2026-11-06.4_smaller: Accepted as the writer proposed: the type-level readouts score, and the key tables' P2/P3 fit on, the trained keys' held-out-row windows (E90's kv_site); held-out values are the held-out keys' windows (windows_*_new.pt); the text ciphers fit on E53's ciphered train rows 0-2399; the state's answer in P2 is its top-1 within S (as P1); the probe cap of 16 is per value and key-slot type.
lead_decisions_2026-11-06.plan_decisions_1_5: Plan 'Questions settled by the lead' 1-5 (2026-11-06): type-level C measured by P0 as filed; P2's g a table (refined by 1 above); do-nothing a rank-matched random basis, rank 1 beside; the text ciphers' site; the locator's block when it passes P0, l* beside.

rules.source: copied unchanged from experiments/case_label/results/predictions.json 'rules' (E112); E112's twin_expected_max is not a rule here (each twin's P3 is printed, as the plan says)

measurements.values: A readout C has m classes (value tokens). Its labels are value indices 0..m-1.
measurements.P0: Per block l = 0-3 (block l's output residual, readout.RESID): one ridge probe per value (one-vs-rest on the value's indicator) on the Pile positions' residuals, read on the scoring windows at the read index as the argmax over the values (case_label.value_probes; ties to the lowest index; a value with no Pile position never wins). Accuracy = top-1 against the scoring windows' classes; control = the same probes fitted to one seeded random value per key-slot type (case_label.control_table, seed 3), read against the scoring windows' key-slot types' random values; selectivity = accuracy - control. l* = case_label.first_passing_block (accuracy >= 0.90 and selectivity >= 0.30, inclusive, the earliest block before the last). Site = the locator's block (E62 copy: 2) when it passes there, else l*. At m = 2 this is E112's P0 exactly (tests/test_case_label.py: test_value_probes_m2_is_e112s_score_over_a_half).

readouts.copy (E62 copy's C, in-context copying): classes: the distinct Bs of E62's 200 read windows. Pile positions: token t-1 occurs exactly once earlier in the window (t-20..t-2) at s, token s+1 is a class (the label), token t-1 is not one of the 32 keys nor the marker. Key slot t-1. Scored on the 200 read windows, class = the window's B. Twin: lookup.
readouts.guess_rank1, guess_elicit (W0's guess): classes: the task's value set S (trained then held-out keys' values, each once). Pile positions: W0's top-1 at t is a class (the label), the token at t not one of the 32 keys. Key slot t. Scored on the held-out keys' windows, class = W0's argmax among the classes there. Twin: cipher-24.
readouts.guess_cipher, guess_broad_cipher (W0's g: classes: the table's 50 / 500 words. Pile positions as above, no excluded types. Key slot t. Scored on the 64 held rows' windows, class = W0's argmax among the classes. No twin.
readouts.identity_ident32, identity_rand32, ident: classes: the task's keys (32; for the 24-key tables trained and held-out keys). Pile positions: the key-slot token is a class (readout.next_token_windows). Key slot t (key tables), t-1 (lookup). Scored on the trained keys' held-out-row windows (lookup: the 200 read windows). Twins: ident32 <-> rand32; copy-24: cipher-24, rank-1, elicit; cipher-24: rank-1, elicit; lookup: E62 copy.

measurements.P1: Held-out carrying (row 87): the state's top-1 within the task's value set S against the target, on the held-out-value windows (24-key tables: the 8 held-out keys' windows; E62 copy: the 200 read windows, Bs never trained). Full-vocabulary top-1 printed beside. n/a with its reason on ident32, rand32 (no held-out keys), lookup (no answer for an unseen key) and the text ciphers (no target for an unseen word). At m = 2 it is E112's label accuracy (test_top1_within_two_values_is_e112s_label_rule).
measurements.P2: Small function (Def 2), as lead's decision 1: the readout's class at the site on W0's residual; identity rows: P2 = agreement of that class with the state's top-1 within S on the held-out windows; table rows: removal.table_accuracy's table (most common state answer per class on the fit windows, ties to the lowest token) read on the held-out windows, an unseen class wrong. nan ('no held-out windows') on ident32 and rand32.
measurements.P3: Removal (row 81's sentence): on the fit windows of the state's own task, G = mean(m_state - m_W0) with m the within-S log-odds of the target (decision 2); share = mean(m_state - m_state with the probe basis removed from the site block's output residual at the read index only) / G (case_label.removed_share; nan when G <= 0.1 nats). Probe basis = the orthonormalised span of the m probe weights at the site (case_label.span_basis), rank m - 1 when every value has a Pile position; at m = 2 E112's unit direction (test_span_basis_rank_and_m2).
measurements.do_nothing: The same share with removal.random_basis(768, rank of the probe basis, [5]) in place of the probe's, on every state read under the C (own and twins), read first; any share over 0.10 stops that C (its P2 and P3 are not read; verdict 'unreadable: ...'). The rank-1 random direction's share (random_basis(768, 1, [5])) printed beside.
measurements.locator: Copied, no computation: E100's own share and sum of single reverts (experiments/fed_or_written/results/table.json, keys part, own, reverts_sum) and E97's removal (experiments/locator_table/results/table.json, keys part, share, control_share, located, reason) per task and seed.
measurements.stage0_control: E112's frozen probes (experiments/case_label/run.py, its loop now case_label.value_probes) on its saved task.pt and settings: accuracy and control per block within 1e-3 of case_label/results/stage0.json (0.683125, 0.99375, 0.885, 0.7625; 0.47625, 0.524375, 0.46375, 0.479375), else exit 1 before anything else runs.

verdict_rule: Unchanged from E112 (case_label.verdict) through case_label.table_verdict: P0 fails (no site) -> 'unreadable'; a part the definition cannot read (P1 n/a, or the do-nothing over 0.10) -> 'unreadable: <reason>' with the numbers shown; P1 >= 0.90, P2 >= 0.90 and P3 >= 0.50 (inclusive) -> 'reuses C'; else 'not through C'. A constant-answer task (lowercase, rand1, emoticon) -> 'does not apply' and is not loaded. The twins' P3 is printed beside; it enters no verdict. No band, clause or score is added.

edge_cases.run: 2026-11-06, tests/test_case_label.py (cpu-run make test: 119 passed with test_removal.py and test_new_vs_reuse.py), before filing
edge_cases.a value with no Pile position (empty cla: its probe has zero weight and intercept and scores -inf: never the argmax, its windows count wrong; it adds nothing to the probe basis (rank drops by one); every value without a position -> accuracy nan, P0 fails ('unreadable'). Tested: test_value_probes_many_values_and_edges, test_span_basis_rank_and_m2.
edge_cases.a state with one answer on every fit win: the table g is constant: P2 = that answer's share of the held-out windows (tested: 0.75 on a hand case). With g the identity, P2 = the share of held-out windows whose class is that answer.
edge_cases.zero gain: G <= 0.1 nats: P3 nan, verdict 'not through C'; a nan do-nothing share is no reading and does not stop (tested: test_table_verdict_edges).
edge_cases.ties: bars inclusive (P1 = P2 = 0.90, P3 = 0.50 -> 'reuses C', tested); probe argmax ties to the lowest value index (torch.argmax's first maximum); a two-value tie reads value 0, as E112's d > 0 reads B (tested); the table's ties to the lowest token.
edge_cases.an empty held-out set: P1 and P2 nan (case_label.agreement, table_accuracy return nan on no rows; tested); never filled from trained keys. Rows with no held-out values read 'unreadable: P1 cannot be applied: <reason>'.
edge_cases.a table at new values: every held-out value unseen on the fit windows -> P2 = 0, unseen = 1 (tested): elicit's 8 held-out values are distinct from its 24 trained ones, so P2 is about 0 there by construction (lead's decision 1: P1's failure seen again, not a new rule).
edge_cases.the do-nothing state: m_state = m_W0 -> G = 0 -> P3 nan -> 'not through C' (tested).
edge_cases.P0 fails: table_verdict(None, ...) = 'unreadable' whatever P1-P3 (tested); that C's stage 2 does not run.
edge_cases.m = 2 reductions: value_probes = E112's score > 0.5 with identical accuracy; set_log_odds = E112's margin; span_basis = E112's unit direction up to sign; identity g = threshold 0.5, sign + (tests named above).

departures: Jain et al. 2024 train the readout on PCFG pretraining data with a PCFG probe; here a ridge probe per value on Pile residuals at one position (E112's form).
Jain put no bound on g; row 87's held-out carrying is the user's dated departure, read as P1.

For a C with more than two values g is the identity on classes where the answer is the readout's value, else a table from readout class to answer fitted on the fit windows; Jain define g only as a function, and E112 measured it as a threshold for two values.
Direction removal is our addition (row 81's sentence); Jain's causal evidence is pruning and reverse fine-tuning, not run here.
The 'pruning a few neurons' form is the locator's part-level revert (E100, E97), copied from JSON, not Jain's App. D Alg. 3.
The Hewitt-Liang control is one random value per key-slot token type; Hewitt and Liang's probes are classifiers, not ridge regressions.
Jain's possession is 'for all x'; here bars of 0.90 and 0.30 filed by E112.
